profile.headline: Senior web developer with 15+ years of experience building and scaling production web applications.
profile.summary:
As a Senior Ecommerce Engineer with over 15 years of experience, I have led the development and optimization of high-traffic ecommerce platforms, specializing in Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce and WordPress. At Filmtools, I delivered custom modules, API-driven integrations, and performance optimization to support complex catalog and checkout workflows, ensuring scalability and cloud readiness for peak traffic events.  

My expertise spans Magento migrations, backend services, REST APIs, and CI/CD pipeline management. I am dedicated to collaborating with marketing and business teams to develop revenue-driving ecommerce features and deliver continuous platform improvements. My goal is to create scalable and efficient systems that empower businesses to thrive in a digital-first economy.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Manage and maintain operational stability for two Shopify storefronts; own day-to-day platform
reliability, performance optimization, and site uptime.
• Design and support customer workflows across both stores; implement process improvements
and operational standards to enhance user experience and conversion.
• Manage product catalog including content creation, product uploads, inventory updates, and
merchandise organization across multiple storefronts.
positions.insights: Skills: Shopify Plus · JavaScript · Liquid Templating Language · Rust (Programming Language) · Airtable · HTML · CSS · Tailwind CSS · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Web Development · E-Commerce · Web Products

positions.title: Senior Ecommerce Engineer
positions.description:
Led development and optimization of Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce and WordPress platforms for high-traffic, multi-brand ecommerce environments. Delivered custom Magento modules, frontend themes, and API-driven integrations supporting complex catalog, merchandising, promotions, and checkout workflows.

Built and maintained backend services, REST APIs, and third-party integrations (payments, marketing, ERP). Drove performance optimization, scalability, and cloud readiness for peak traffic events. Owned CI/CD pipelines, deployments, and release management.

Partnered cross-functionally with marketing, merchandising, and business teams to deliver revenue-driving ecommerce features and continuous platform improvements.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Orchestrated full-stack operations for 5 Magento 2 websites managing 33,000+ product SKUs across multi-brand portfolio. Engineered custom Magento modules and frontend architecture supporting complex merchandising workflows and revenue optimization. Architected CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker; standardized deployment infrastructure and reduced operational risk. Designed performance optimization strategy: optimized MySQL queries, implemented Redis caching, configured Varnish page cache, and deployed asset optimization. Orchestrated GraphQL API integration alongside REST APIs connecting Magento 2 to Braintree, PayPal, Authorize.net payment systems and third-party inventory/analytics platforms. Negotiated vendor contracts and managed ongoing relationships with technology partners; ensured SLA compliance and alignment with platform roadmap.

positions.title: Senior Ecommerce Engineer
positions.description:
Owned day-to-day management, optimization, and reliability of WordPress and Shopify ecommerce sites, ensuring platform stability, performance, and operational excellence. Planned and executed Magento / Adobe Commerce migration strategy to enable scalable ecommerce growth.

Implemented Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, and enhanced analytics to support marketing performance, attribution, and data-driven decision-making. Coordinated with vendors and technology partners to support site launches, integrations, and ongoing platform reliability.

Led scalability and process standardization initiatives to reduce technical risk and improve operational efficiency. Partnered with marketing, ecommerce, and business teams to align platform capabilities with revenue and growth objectives.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Assumed operational ownership of WordPress and Shopify properties; maintained 24/7 platform reliability and performance for consumer health products. Architected Magento 2 migration strategy; engineered phased implementation roadmap with zero-downtime cutover, minimizing business disruption. Designed analytics infrastructure via Google Tag Manager integration; enabled marketing insights and improved performance measurement capabilities. Negotiated vendor contracts and SLA agreements; secured favorable terms aligned with operational requirements.

positions.title: Senior E-Commerce Engineer
positions.description:
Served as an Ecommerce Engineer at Crimson Agility, delivering Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce development, maintenance, and support for enterprise and mid-market clients. Led Magento 1 to Magento 2 migrations, upgrades, and replatforming initiatives with minimal business disruption.

Performed Magento version upgrades, code reviews, and deployments to staging and production environments. Designed and built custom Magento modules, features, and frontend themes tailored to client requirements. Provided advanced troubleshooting and debugging for complex Magento core and third-party extension issues.

Recognized with the Sharp Shooter Award for outstanding client support and delivery in consecutive quarters.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description: Spearheaded enterprise Magento 1 to Magento 2 migration program; architected migration strategy, executed risk assessment, and stabilized production post-launch—achieving zero downtime. Established platform governance framework: defined code quality standards, formulated release protocols, and implemented QA procedures ensuring production stability and security. Engineered custom features and integrations; translated business requirements into scalable architectural solutions delivered on schedule. Optimized platform reliability across high-traffic operations; reduced unplanned downtime and lowered infrastructure costs through systematic performance tuning.

positions.title: E-commerce Engineer
positions.description:
Delivered Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce development, maintenance, and support for enterprise and mid-market clients. Led Magento 1 → Magento 2 migrations, platform upgrades, and replatforming projects with minimal business disruption.

Performed code reviews, version upgrades, and deployments across staging and production. Built custom modules, features, and frontend themes, and provided advanced troubleshooting for Magento core and third-party extensions. Recognized with the Sharp Shooter Award for outstanding client support in consecutive quarters.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Managed and maintained WordPress and Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce websites, codebases, repositories, and databases for multiple brands, ensuring reliability, scalability, and high performance. Designed, developed, and supported full-stack environments and customized third-party extensions and API integrations to meet complex business and workflow requirements across subsidiaries including Moviola, Filmtools, Polyline Corp, and ProVideo Coalition.
